title: Fox in the Artist's Studio
description: A realistic fox with glowing blue markings on its face and shoulder stands alert in a dimly lit, cluttered artist's studio. On the wooden table to the left sits a lit oil lamp, scattered fruit, a palette, and brushes, while a detailed map lies on the floor near a paintbrush.
prompt: A highly detailed fox with glowing blue mystical markings on its face and shoulder stands in an old cluttered artist's studio at night. A green glass oil lamp casts warm light on a wooden table covered with fruit, a palette, brushes and cloth. An intricate map lies on the wooden floor beside a large paintbrush. Ornate classical paintings and blue patterned wallpaper adorn the walls, creating a mysterious and atmospheric scene.
